[146] yato ca kho bhikkhave no ca 3 ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti ārammaṇametaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā ārammaṇe #1 yu. kho . 2 ma. yu. ce . evamuparipi . 3 ma. yu. ceva . asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti tadappatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷeha āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hoti āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā asati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotīti . aṭṭhamaṃ .
